source.name: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates Fixwell
source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository template is under MIT. Its retained per-template credits identify the sole bundled photograph as CC0/Public Domain; remaining graphic treatments are CSS. Both notices are included in this dossier.

provenance.capture: Pinned template rendered locally at 1440px and 390px content widths. Lazy images were loaded before capture; a closed off-canvas drawer was hidden only for the mobile capture because it otherwise expanded the page canvas. Visible content and source markup were unchanged.
provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT. Per-template image provenance is retained; source footer remains visible in both screenshots.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A practical home-service page with a narrow utility call strip, compact navigation, and a wide hero where a short problem-led promise shares the opening with a quote form. A service index groups jobs by need, followed by a coverage checker, a short numbered process, recent work and review examples, a question/contact split, and footer. Sample prices, availability, guarantees, reviews, locations, and credentials are fictional template content.

heroGeometry.alignment: short left problem statement over a bright work-context image with a bounded quote form on the right
heroGeometry.viewport: headline, one useful sentence, core form fields and request action fit within the first desktop screen

navigationGeometry.placement: thin optional utility strip above a compact white header
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand and one call/request action stay near the top; remaining anchors are compact

typography.scale: short heavy problem statement, compact labels, body copy in small decision-ready blocks

palette.contrastIntent: high legibility with one blue action color and clear input borders

imageTreatment.mode: bright job-context hero with restrained overlay
imageTreatment.crop: wide cover hero and smaller work-proof rectangles
imageTreatment.focalPoint: work setting supports but does not compete with the headline and quote form

servicePresentation.pattern: problem-oriented service index with short scope explanations
servicePresentation.interaction: coverage lookup or verified area list and concise service selection

ctaPlacement.early: inside hero, adjacent to the opening promise

motion.primitive: lookup and form state only when connected to a real endpoint
motion.library: native form controls and browser events
motion.reducedMotion: show static coverage guidance, all service options and native FAQ disclosure

mobileRecomposition.strategy: promise-first single column with inline quote path
rules: keep labels attached to full-width fields
stack services and process in reading order
replace map/grid with verified list if needed
do not fix overflow by clipping content

prohibitedPatterns: invented same-day availability or response times
unverified call-out fees, minimums or hourly prices
coverage presented as a physical office
stock work photo presented as completed client work
fake postcode lookup or success message

requiredSignatureElements.description: bounded quote form integrated into the opening scene
service choices organized around visitor needs
real coverage lookup or verified service-area list
short practical sequence explaining what happens next

acceptanceChecks: the opening identifies the actual trade and useful next step
quote form submits to a real endpoint and reports failure honestly
prices and availability appear only from verified client facts
coverage is accurate and does not imply an unverified office
reviews/work evidence are authentic and approved
mobile form and service list fit at 390px with no horizontal overflow

review.scope: pinned MIT template, CC0 photo evidence, full-page desktop/mobile captures, and transferable local-service mechanics
